name: RPA Core
description: Run deterministic desktop & browser automations built from 89 typed atomic actions.
description_zh: 把 89 条现成原子能力编排成工作流并确定性运行：浏览器、Windows 桌面、数据与 OCR。
description_en: Orchestrate 89 typed atomic actions into validated, deterministic workflows: browser, Windows desktop, data and OCR.
examples_zh: 打开必应搜 RPA，把前 10 条标题存成 JSON
每天把内网报表页的表格抓下来追加到 CSV
在记事本里输入一段固定文本并保存
这个流程报 ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND，帮我重新捕获元素并修好
examples_en: Search Bing for RPA and save the top 10 titles as JSON
Grab the intranet report table every day and append it to a CSV
Type a fixed text into Notepad and save it
This flow fails with ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND — re-capture the element and fix it
